card.name: Emergency-care terms in overdose and airway text
card.fires_on: Partway through or right after emergency-care words, such as the end of flumazenil, airway obstruction, intubation, convulsions, and activate the emergency medical system. It appears in overdose, angioedema and resuscitation passages.

modes.label: Inside emergency drug and procedure words
modes.description: The ending or middle of words like flumazenil, intubation and convulsions.
modes.example: the recommended initial dose of Flumazen<<il>> Injection, USP is 0.

modes.label: Airway emergency wording
modes.description: Words in airway-blockage or emergency-system warnings, such as obstruction or activate.
modes.example: If angioedema involves the tongue, glottis or larynx, airway<< obstruction>> may occur and be fatal.

card.writes: It suppresses words meaning emergency, first aid and rescue, mostly Chinese terms plus English emergency.
card.plain: It marks spots in emergency-treatment text where the next word is already set up by the emergency context.
